Verba Amos qui fuit in pastoralibus: The words of Amos, who was among herdsmen
in diebus Ozie regis Iude et in diebus I: in the days of Ozias, king of Juda, and in the days of Jeroboam, the son of Joas, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake
et luxerunt speciosa pastorum: and the beautiful places of the shepherds have mourned
SPECIOSA PASTORUM: the beautiful places of the shepherds
and the top of Carmel is withered

eo quod trituraverit in plaustris ferrei: because they have thrashed Galaad with iron wains
and it shall devour the houses of Benadad
Et conteram vectes Damasci: And I will break the bar of Damascus
et disperdam habitatores de campo idoli: and I will cut off the inhabitants from the plain of the idol
et tenentem sceptrum de domo voluptatis: and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of pleasure
populus Syrie Cyrenen: the people of Syria … to Cyrene
Hec dicit Dominus: Super tribus scelerib: Thus saith the Lord: For three crimes of Gaza
et super quatuor non convertam eum eo qu: and for four, I will not convert it, because they have carried away a perfect captivity to shut them up in Edom
Et disperdam habitatorem de Azoto: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Azotus
et tenentem sceptrum: and him that holdeth the sceptre
et convertam manum meam: and I will turn my hand
Hec dicit Dominus super tribus sceleribu: Thus saith the Lord: For three crimes of Tyre
et super quatuor non convertam eum eo qu: and for four, I will not convert it: because they have shut up an entire captivity in Edom, and have not remembered the covenant of brethren
Et emittam ignem in murum Tyri et devora: And I will send a fire upon the wall of Tyre, and it shall devour the houses thereof
Hec dicit Dominus: super tribus scelerib: Thus saith the Lord: For three crimes of Edom, and for four, I will not convert him: because he hath pursued his brother with the sword, and hath cast off all pity, and hath carried on
furorem suum et indignationem suam serva: his fury, and hath kept his wrath to the end
and it shall devour the houses of Bosra
SUPER TRIBUS SCELERIBUS FILIORUM AMON: For three crimes of the children of Ammon
et super quatuor non convertam eum eo qu: and for four, I will not convert him: because he hath ript up the women with child, of Galaad, to enlarge his border
et devorabit edes eius in ululatu: and it shall devour the houses thereof with shouting
in die belli et in turbine: in the day of battle, and with a whirlwind
Hec dicit Dominus: super tribus scelerib: Thus saith the Lord: For three crimes of Moab, and for four, I will not convert him: because he hath burnt the bones of the king of Edom even to ashes
Et mittam ignem in Moab: And I will send a fire into Moab
et devorabit edes Carioth: and it shall devour the houses of Carioth
et morietur in sonitu Moab in clangore t: and Moab shall die with a noise, with the sound of the trumpet
disperdam iudicem de medio eius et omnes: I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all his princes with him, saith the Lord
Hec dicit Dominus: super tribus scelerib: Thus saith the Lord: For three crimes of Juda, and for four, I will not convert him: because he hath cast away the law of the Lord
et mandata eius non custodierint deceper: and hath not kept his commandments: for their idols have caused them to err
after which their fathers have walked
and it shall devour the houses of Jerusalem
hec dicit Dominus: super tribus scelerib: Thus saith the Lord: For three crimes of Israel
et super quatuor non convertam eum pro e: and for four, I will not convert him: because he hath sold … for silver
iustum et pauperem: the just man … and the poor man
ET PAUPEREM PRO CALCIAMENTIS: and the poor man for a pair of shoes

et viam humilium declinant: and turn aside the way of the humble
ac pater eius ierunt ad puellam ut viola: and his father have gone to the same young woman, to profane my holy name

cedrorum altitudo eius: was like the height of cedars

Et peribit fuga a veloce: And flight shall perish from the swift
et fortis non obtinebit virtutem suam et: and the valiant shall not possess his strength, neither shall the strong

et velox pedibus suis non salvabitur: and the swift of foot shall not escape

super omnem cognatione quam eduxi de ter: concerning the whole family that I brought up out of the land of Egypt

cadet avis in laqueum terre absque aucup: the bird fall into the snare upon the earth, if there be no fowler?

si erit malum in civitate: Shall there be evil in a city

Dominus Deus locutus est, quis non proph: The Lord God hath spoken, who shall not prophesy?
et in edibus terre Egypti et dicite: Con: and in the houses of the land of Egypt, and say: Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria

et nescierunt facere rectum, dicit Domin: And they have not known to do the right thing, saith the Lord

et detrahetur: and … shall be taken away from thee

que estis in monte Samarie: that are in the mountains of Samaria

et proiciemini in Armon: and you shall be cast forth into Armon

in cunctis urbibus vestris et indigentia: in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places

et non redistis ad me,: yet you returned not to me

quasi torris raptus de incendio: as a firebrand plucked out of the burning
et non redistis ad me, dicit Dominus: yet you returned not to me, saith the Lord

erit Dominus Deus: the Lord the God … will be
